name: Weather Prime
description:
Weather Prime brings a polished, full-featured weather station to your GNOME top bar. A clean pill shows current conditions at a glance, and a single click opens a rich, tabbed drop-down packed with everything from live radar to tide times.

☀️ CURRENT CONDITIONS
• Temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, gusts, dew point, visibility, and cloud cover
• Barometric pressure with a smart trend arrow that hints at incoming weather
• Last-24h precipitation total with an hour-by-hour sparkline, plus a separate snowfall depth when it's snowing

📈 FORECASTS
• Hourly — a 12-hour outlook with temperature, precipitation chance, humidity, and wind
• 7-Day — daily highs and lows, precipitation, humidity, and wind, plus a plain-language daily narrative for US locations (NWS, keyless)

🌬️ AIR QUALITY
• Pick AirNow (US EPA AQI per pollutant), OpenWeatherMap (global 1–5 AQI plus all eight pollutants), or Open-Meteo PM2.5 / PM10
• Automatic source fallback so you always see a reading

🌙 ASTRONOMY
• Sunrise and sunset, moonrise and moonset, moon phase, and illumination — no key required
• Solar noon plus the dates of the next new and full moon (keyless USNO data)
• Optional tide line showing today's high and low times (NOAA, US coastal, keyless)

🗺️ LIVE RADAR MAP
• Animated RainViewer precipitation radar (past frames + nowcast) layered over Esri satellite imagery
• Play/pause control; one click launches Windy, Zoom Earth, Ventusky, RainViewer, Weather.com, Wunderground, or NWS Radar for full interactivity

⚠️ SEVERE-WEATHER ALERTS
• Live NWS alerts surface automatically for US locations, complete with the full alert text

⚙️ MADE YOUR WAY
• Auto-locate via GeoClue2, or set your spot manually with built-in city search
• Theme follows your system light/dark setting — or pin it the way you like
• Panel sits left, center, or right at original, medium (1.25×), or large (1.5×) size
• Independently configurable refresh cadence for weather, air quality, and radar

✨ Works out of the box — no API keys, no signup, no fees. Optional free keys from WeatherAPI.com, WeatherAI.io, AirNow, and OpenWeatherMap unlock the extra providers whenever you want them.
